s: Sherauy lomar retzeh bekol tepilla ubo b' seipim: omerim "retzeh" bekol hattepillot, velo keotan shennohagim lehatchil bemincha ubearbit "veishshe yisrael utepillatam ku'", sheen taam leminhagam:

"Veishshe yisrael" hen nishmot hatztzaddiqim shemmaqrib mikael sar haggadol al hammizbeach shel mala (ulematta — hen haqqorbanot shemmaqribim hatztzaddiqim umoserim napshotehem lehaqqadosh baruk hu al kol dibbur vedibbur hayyotze mippihem hamkunneh beshem "mizbeach") (beahaba rabba habbaa alehem milmala al yede mikael sar hachesed), vezo hi tepilla hanniqra "aboda shebballeb". Vehaqqorbanot ellu shehen beesh hahitlahabut — niqraot "ishshe yisrael", "utepillatam" — hi gup hattepilla shehen teboteha:
